title: services: openvpn: servers: authUserPass: allow to be a path
reason: Real type widening: authUserPass changes from submodule-only to oneOf[singleLineStr, submodule] (accepts a bare credentials-file path OR the existing username/password attrset).
targets_toml: option_prefix=[services,openvpn,servers], watch=['testserver.authUserPass']. 'servers' is attrsOf(submodule) -- the real test instance name 'testserver' only exists in nixos/tests/initrd-network-openvpn/default.nix's config, not in the base module, so it cannot be statically enumerated from the module alone.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: CONSISTENT WITH PRE-EXISTING DOCUMENTED GAP (not new): 'servers' is types.attrsOf(types.submodule(...)) -- the same wildcard attrsOf(submodule) shape already catalogued at wstunnel, frp, and kanidm's provision.groups. Total non-discovery both sides, unchanged transition. NOT tallied as a new gap. Confirmed the real test does exercise services.openvpn.servers.testserver (a real module+test pairing exists, hence applicable), it just never sets authUserPass.
